purpose: Prove no metric name is hardcoded in the builder
method: Static scan of the V6.0E modules for literal table names metric names and scenario strings outside the registry
expected_result: Zero literals outside the registry and its loader

purpose: Prove the normalized artifact matches the canonical contract
method: Compare the header against canonical_metric_columns.csv and type check each column
expected_result: All 44 columns present in order with valid types

purpose: Prove scenario is never blank or null
method: Assert on the scenario column
expected_result: Zero blank or null values

purpose: Prove sources without a scenario column are accepted
method: Build from the four metrics tables
expected_result: All rows carry scenario=not_applicable and scenario_status=not_applicable with no error

purpose: Prove Enterprise is never defaulted onto a source lacking the column
method: Assert scenario=Enterprise only where the source physically has a Scenario column
expected_result: Zero violations

purpose: Prove every frozen artifact is byte identical
method: Rehash the 14 entries of hdd_baseline_freeze.csv
expected_result: All hashes match the freeze

purpose: Prove SSD variants never merge
method: Assert source_object_count equals one for every ranking row unless merge_sources_allowed is true
expected_result: Zero blended ranking rows where the legacy build produced 137

purpose: Prove granularities never merge
method: Assert every ranking group resolves to a single key_namespace
expected_result: Zero groups spanning namespaces

purpose: Prove units never mix inside a group
method: Assert exactly one distinct unit per ranking group
expected_result: Zero groups with more than one unit

purpose: Prove the identity tuple is a true key
method: Assert uniqueness on the six part tuple
expected_result: Zero duplicate tuples

purpose: Prove rows are only emitted for available sources
method: Assert availability_status of every emitted row
expected_result: Only local_ingested or partially_available appear

purpose: Prove one version never yields drift
method: Assert drift_computable and cross_plan_computable for single version sources
expected_result: Both false and status equals single_version_accuracy_only

purpose: Prove options are data driven
method: Assert every option in metric_filter_options.csv resolves to normalized rows or to a declared disabled reason
expected_result: Zero orphan or hardcoded options

purpose: Prove the dependency chain is complete
method: Walk Metric to DB Type to Scenario to Granularity to Key to Forecast Version
expected_result: Every level has at least one valid child or an explicit disabled reason

purpose: Prove full traceability
method: Assert every source_file appears in metric_source_lineage.csv with rows_in rows_out and sha256
expected_result: Zero untraceable rows

purpose: Prove failing rows are flagged and kept
method: Compare input and output row counts per source
expected_result: rows_out equals rows_in and quality issues appear as flags

purpose: Prove provenance of the contract
method: Assert contract_version on every row
expected_result: All rows carry v6.0d

purpose: Use the first validation case without hardcoding it
method: Query the normalized artifact generically for the key and inspect granularity
expected_result: granularity=forest and key_namespace=forest_keys across HDD forest and both SSD variants

purpose: Prove HDD values survive normalisation unchanged
method: Compare HDD measures row by row against the source extracts
expected_result: Every measure identical to the source

purpose: Prove Track A boundaries
method: Scan the build for database drivers and connections
expected_result: Zero database calls

purpose: Prove no cloud interaction
method: Scan the build for Azure SDK and CLI usage
expected_result: Zero Azure calls

purpose: Prove raw stays producer only
method: Assert no artifact contains data/raw paths or raw business rows
expected_result: Zero exposure

purpose: Prove no credential leaks
method: Pattern scan for server names connection strings keys and tokens
expected_result: Zero matches

purpose: Prove container visibility
method: Assert every new artifact path sits under data/processed or outputs
expected_result: All artifacts visible under the read-only mounts

purpose: Prove honest absence
method: Inspect an unavailable metric such as CPU
expected_result: A status and a reason are present and no zero valued rows exist

purpose: Prove the explanation panel survives the expansion
method: Render every page that has an assistant today and assert the panel button and quick prompts exist
expected_result: All existing assistants present and interactive

purpose: Prove grounding still resolves
method: Load the legacy pack and the new pack and assert both parse and index correctly
expected_result: 11 legacy page responses plus the new selection entries load

purpose: Prove the narrative reflects the active selection
method: Select a metric db_type granularity and key then request an explanation
expected_result: Answer names the metric variant granularity key and forecast version correctly

purpose: Prove the assistant justifies capability
method: Select a single version source and ask whether it can be compared across plans
expected_result: Answer states drift is not available and cites the reason code

method: Select a source whose scenario_status is not_applicable and ask about scenarios
expected_result: Answer states the source has no scenario dimension and never names Enterprise

purpose: Prove the honesty rule in prose
method: Scan generated narrative for drift trend deterioration or improvement wording on single version sources
expected_result: Zero occurrences
